facts.text: RoboschoolInvertedPendulum-v1 is registered with entry point roboschool:RoboschoolInvertedPendulum, max_episode_steps 1000 and reward_threshold 950.0
RoboschoolInvertedPendulum is a continuous-control inverted pendulum: keep a pole upright by moving the 1-D cart
The class is constructed with action_dim 1 and obs_dim 5
The action space is Box(-high, high) with high = np.ones([action_dim]), so with action_dim 1 it is bounded by -1 and 1; the observation space is Box(-inf*ones([obs_dim]), inf*ones([obs_dim]))
The scene uses gravity 9.8, timestep 0.0165 s and frame_skip 1
The pole hinge angle is drawn uniformly from -0.1 to 0.1 radians before each episode
Each step applies a motor torque of 100 times the action clipped to -1..1
The observation is [cart position, cart velocity, cos(theta), sin(theta), theta angular velocity]
A non-swingup step rewards 1.0 and terminates when the absolute pole angle exceeds 0.2 radians
RoboschoolInvertedPendulum.step is the legacy Gym API: it returns the four-tuple (state, reward, done, info)
The base environment seeds its numpy generator with gym.utils.seeding.np_random(seed) and returns [seed]
The base reset recreates the scene, resets the robot and returns the initial observation

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the pole angle and the dynamics are deterministic, so the package fake repeats a trajectory for one seed and actions; upstream draws the angle from its numpy generator, so a seed gives different trajectories on the fake and the upstream scene, and nothing here was compared with a real run

gaps: the fake is a pure Python cart-pole stand-in for the interface; its masses, inertia, contacts, damping and motor model are not the Bullet scene of roboschool/mujoco_assets/inverted_pendulum.xml and it was not compared with the upstream environment
the fake reports truncation at the registered 1000 steps to mirror the TimeLimit wrapper that gym.make adds; the bare upstream class step returns a four-tuple and never truncates
reset options are accepted by the family bridge but ignored: the upstream reset takes no options
no rendering: the upstream camera_adjust and HUD paths are not modelled
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
